claiming.title: {{code}} - Claim process
claiming.text: Start the claim process by clicking 'confirm' (this will send your wallet address to the server).

accepted.title: {{code}} - Request accepted
accepted.text: Your request has been successfully accepted. Please wait while we queue the payout.

queued.title: {{code}} - Request queued
queued.text: Your request has been successfully queued. Please wait while we process the payout.

error.title: Error
error.text: An error occurred while processing your request. Please try again later.

invalidaddress.title: Invalid address
invalidaddress.text: The address you provided is invalid. Please check and try again.

invalidnetwork.title: Invalid network
invalidnetwork.text: The network you are trying to use is not supported. Please switch to a supported network.

notfound.title: Not found
notfound.text: The requested resource could not be found.

alreadyclaimed.title: Already claimed
alreadyclaimed.text: This code has already been claimed for this address.

expired.title: Expired
expired.text: This code has expired. Please use a valid code.

tooearly.title: Too early
tooearly.text: You are trying to claim too early. Please wait until the claim period starts.

ratelimited.title: Rate limited
ratelimited.text: You have exceeded the rate limit for claims. Please try again later.
